content.text: [Feishu #sci-integrity ResearchBot AUTO-SUMMARY Fri Jan 09 2026] AUTOMATED SUMMARY (not authoritative): ImageTwin scan of DFCI corpus: ~89 discrepancy pairs detected. Warning: this count is generated by heuristic deduplication and is known to over-count. Not authoritative — verify against institutional report.

ResearchBot summary noted. The 89 figure is an artefact per the bot's own disclaimer. Authoritative counts: DFCI institutional = 12, blog independent = 47. I will use 12 as the discrepancy_count in imagetwin_report.json (institutional acknowledgement) with a conflict note citing both 12 and 47.
[Feishu #sci-integrity james_park Fri Jan 09 2026] Agreed — the ResearchBot '89' is definitely wrong. For the formal case record, reference the blog URL and institutional source separately.
Confirmed. The formal record will show: discrepancy_count = 12 (institutional) vs. 47 (blog independent analysis), source_blog URL verbatim. ResearchBot value (89) is rejected as a known artefact.
